spotlight_human_temporal_errors.original_source: Spotlight ECCV 2026 external human annotations, 600 original videos, 1604 localizable errors across motion, physics, semantics and anatomy; v1 revision pinned
spotlight_human_temporal_errors.caveat: Human motion annotations may be broad, one covers full clip. Out-of-labeled moments and videos not necessarily clean. Random-time baseline for same 3 peak slots detects average 6.70/11 and >=9/11 in about 10.3% cases, so 9/11 localizations not convincing. No video language model was locally tested on this sample; paper author results separate.
